Why
PR82 already contains the completed native NCP execution of C21F. Its native-source hybrid row appears to converge faster than order two at the stored resolutions; signed errors and a reference-free comparison are needed to interpret that observation.

## This PR
Adds only research/cr_c21f_native_assessment_20261019/ on top of PR82. The original C21F execution source f8359232df8d0dd4fe91fcdabeb6701eb06089ba and all raw PR82 evidence remain unchanged. No recovery patch, automatic merge or old matrix/test rerun.

- Freshly verify 167 raw text files and all 17 executable-manifest source/test/dependency files. Manifest payload coverage is 166/168; two native binary byte readbacks remain explicitly unverified.
- Independently analyze 24 histories, 2 optical-depth Radau references and 2,160 accepted steps.
- Independently audit 27,140 saved native request/response pairs, with the original physical tolerances and no scoped violations.
- Derive the frozen-cell hybrid local gas defect h^2/2 DgM(Pg+M)+O(h^3). The signed hybrid−FULLMID difference exposes a first-order contribution; native hybrid apparent high order includes thermal cancellation and a maximum-component switch.
- Preserve component CSVs, exact-data PNG/SVG figures, Korean report, independent review, DAG and next-session handoff.

## Validation and scope
New analyzer tests 5/5 PASS; analyzer v3 exit 0; independent cross-review PASS_SCOPED. Historical Python56/Rust3/native24 executions are reused, not rerun. No blanket red-first claim.

FULLMID supports second-order time refinement in these two fixed fixtures. Radau tolerance is not an absolute physical-state error bound. Reference-tolerance calibration and, if needed, only new native-source n=128/256 levels remain next. Current NCP campaign/resource inventory was blocked by the device service monthly quota, so no new remote job was launched.

Full48, source-age/spectral/angular, Case B, signed Bianchi, standalone Grackle driver parity and full EoR remain HOLD pending independent validation.
